![How to Remove Under-Eye Wrinkles?](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10090947-1509-0139-0000-da8b0a014d42:4)
Under-eye wrinkles `happen because the skin around your eyes is the thinnest on your body, has very few oil glands, and loses collagen and elasticity as you age`.[[1]](https://imageskincare.com/blogs/skincare-blog/how-to-get-rid-of-dark-circles-and-under-eye-wrinkles-clinical-solutions-that-actually-work)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rIxC0Jg750o)[[3]](https://tula.com/blogs/news/how-can-i-reduce-under-eye-fine-lines)

### Types of Under-Eye Wrinkles

- **Static wrinkles:** Lines visible even when your face is completely relaxed, caused by natural aging, moisture loss, and a breakdown of collagen and elastin.
- **Dynamic wrinkles:** Lines that form from repetitive muscle movements like smiling, squinting, or blinking.
- **Wrinkle folds:** Deeper grooves caused by a loss of fat and structural support in the tear trough or upper cheek area.[[1]](https://www.dermacaresandiego.com/how-to-get-rid-of-wrinkles-around-the-eyes/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rIxC0Jg750o)

### Common Causes

- **Natural aging:** Slower cell turnover and a drop in collagen production.
- **Sun exposure:** Ultraviolet (UV) rays break down collagen and account for a major portion of external skin aging.
- **Dehydration and lifestyle:** Lacking water, poor sleep, rubbing your eyes, and smoking reduce skin bounce and trigger premature creasing.[[1]](https://platedskinscience.com/blogs/plated-skin-science-blog/under-eye-wrinkles-why-wrinkles-under-your-eyes-appear-and-the-best-treatments-to-fix-the-look-of-them)[[2]](https://imageskincare.com/blogs/skincare-blog/how-to-get-rid-of-dark-circles-and-under-eye-wrinkles-clinical-solutions-that-actually-work)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G7Bz-ki5Q8k&t=16)

### Effective Treatments

- **Topical Skincare:** 
	- *Hydration:* Look for hyaluronic acid or glycerin to plump fine lines on contact.
	- *Cell Turnover & Firmness:* Low-strength or encapsulated retinol, peptides (such as palmitoyl tripeptide-38), and vitamin C stimulate collagen. Products like [The Ordinary Multi-Peptide Eye Serum Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462741665863616,imageDocid:10572888380648912492,gpcid:14130735510744469954,headlineOfferDocid:164665189183155342,catalogid:3469811344302208356,productDocid:8529217129482160656,rds:PC_14130735510744469954%7CPROD_PC_14130735510744469954&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjo_d3a06yXAxWqUqQEHeL7OY4Qxa4PegoIAggACAEIKRAJ) (~$25) or [Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair Eye Lift + Sculpt Eye Cream Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462833480804026,imageDocid:16959738338622515558,gpcid:16662907766089130944,headlineOfferDocid:17805254305647634518,catalogid:8984059007520959808,productDocid:11470687556951321117,rds:PC_16662907766089130944%7CPROD_PC_16662907766089130944&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjo_d3a06yXAxWqUqQEHeL7OY4Qxa4PegoIAggACAEIKRAL) (~$88) target texture and firmness.[[1]](https://tula.com/blogs/news/how-can-i-reduce-under-eye-fine-lines)[[2]](https://www.dermacaresandiego.com/how-to-get-rid-of-wrinkles-around-the-eyes/)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:8529217129482160656,catalogid:3469811344302208356,gpcid:14130735510744469954,mid:576462741665863616&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:11470687556951321117,catalogid:8984059007520959808,gpcid:16662907766089130944,mid:576462833480804026&ibp=oshop)
- **In-Office Procedures:** 
	- *Resurfacing & Tightening:* Laser resurfacing, radiofrequency (RF) microneedling, and chemical peels help remodel delicate tissue as noted by dermatology centers like [DermaCare San Diego](https://www.dermacaresandiego.com/how-to-get-rid-of-wrinkles-around-the-eyes/).
	- *Injectables:* Soft hyaluronic acid fillers or biostimulators can address volume loss, while tiny amounts of neuromodulators (Botox) can relax dynamic lines. Evaluating your specific skin anatomy with a provider is essential for a safe choice, as outlined by California Skin Institute.[[1]](https://prasadcosmeticsurgery.com/under-eye-wrinkles-fillers/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/VCyGqaJuDpQ)[[3]](https://www.dermacaresandiego.com/how-to-get-rid-of-wrinkles-around-the-eyes/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rIxC0Jg750o)[[5]](https://clderm.com/best-treatments-for-under-eye-wrinkles-and-crepey-sikin/)

### Prevention Tips

- Wear daily **SPF** and sunglasses to block UV rays and prevent squinting.
- Apply eye creams or serums gently using your **ring finger** to avoid tugging the skin.
- Stop rubbing your eyes (especially if you suffer from seasonal allergies).
- Get **7 to 9 hours** of quality sleep nightly to support natural skin repair.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/dM5Pah6P2Lk)[[2]](https://tula.com/blogs/news/how-can-i-reduce-under-eye-fine-lines)[[3]](https://platedskinscience.com/blogs/plated-skin-science-blog/under-eye-wrinkles-why-wrinkles-under-your-eyes-appear-and-the-best-treatments-to-fix-the-look-of-them)

If you'd like to narrow this down, tell me:

- Are your lines **visible at rest** or mostly when you **smile**?
- What **products** are you currently using in your routine?
